families.title: Single-Run Order Finding: Complete Factorization
families.construction: Complete factorization with overall success tending to one using one quantum order-finding run and polynomial classical postprocessing.

families.title: Complete Factorization of Special Integers
families.construction: Theorem 5.3 reduces complete factorization of special integers to amplified squarefree-part-or-prime extraction; Corollary 5.4 instantiates it quantumly.

parameters.name: N
parameters.domain: Positive integer with pairwise-distinct prime exponents.

parameters.name: T
parameters.domain: $T=\omega(\log N)$; polynomially bounded choices give polynomial overhead.

evidence.locator: PDF pp. 33–36 / printed pp. 31–34, Definition 5.1, Lemma 5.2, Theorem 5.3, Algorithm 5.1 and Corollary 5.4.

families.title: Large-Order Element or Factor
families.construction: Deterministic output of either an invertible residue with order greater than D or a nontrivial divisor of N.

evidence.locator: PDF/printed pp. 3–4, Theorem 1.1, Equation (1.2), small-D convention and space remark; Section 3 algorithm and proof.

families.title: Balanced Semiprimes via Rank-3 Lattices

families.title: Deterministic Quadratic-Image Sieving
families.construction: Author-proved general deterministic factorization bound using quadratic-image restrictions and the large-order subroutine.

families.title: Oracle-Assisted Factoring of Almost All Inputs
families.construction: With the specified elliptic-curve point-count-multiple oracle, Theorem 1.2 deterministically finds a nontrivial factor for almost all inputs in the bounded population.

evidence.locator: PDF/printed pp. 5–7, Definition 1.1, Theorem 1.2, Remark 1.5 and oracle-cost discussion; pp. 13–14, Algorithm 3.1.

families.title: RSA-155 with CUDA-MPQS
families.construction: Reported complete factorization of RSA-155 with GPU-assisted self-initializing quadratic sieving.

evidence.locator: PDF pp. 8–9, Section V-G (RSA-155); PDF p. 3, Section IV-B host residuals; PDF p. 7, Table III.

coverage.selection: Ten selected papers with publication or inspected revisions in 2023–2026. Targeted theorem/algorithm/run extraction, not the ten globally newest papers or an exhaustive factorization survey. The 2024 Ekerå publication is represented by its explicitly dated 2022 preprint.
not_yet_covered: Historical GNFS/SNFS, ECM, quadratic-sieve and Shor baselines are not a completed census.
No automatic frontier certification across symbolic bounds, auxiliary oracles, special inputs or hardware units.
No full-paper result inventories, formal proof audits, factor-witness replay or end-to-end reproductions.
Unselected parameter tradeoffs and secondary results in these papers require separate targeted extraction.
Regev v3 has an unresolved success-probability statement mismatch.

exclusions.reason: Standalone circuit/space optimizations are excluded; the algorithm-level noise-robust postprocessing result in Theorem 4.5 is included.
Standalone gate/depth/qubit optimization is excluded; the special-integer complete-factorization reduction in Section 5 is included.
